notes.title: Version 1.0
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33845009/16a0b9b99936a24e60099510a553c54b42abc34c.png

Hello everyone,

after a very long time, we decided to leave early access with our game.

The game is in a very stable state and basically nothing prevented this for a long time.

Version 1.0 now includes:

Slightly adjusted performance - in some situations..
Archers now gain experience points and advance a level.
With the new level, they change the color of the hood + increase their attack.


01.02.001:

There is no longer an unexpected memory leak and the game no longer crashes.


Game performance still has bad results in the final stages of the game (when you have a lot of archers or you are in a 50+ game day).
We will continue to work on this performance solution for the final fix.

We also wanted to implement some extra features we planned. But unfortunately, it was not possible to implement these functions into an existing project without breaking the current version of the game a lot.

Without these features, the game is still fun and can be played without any problem.
We may be implementing the features that were planned in some future updates (we will see how everything can be solved.).

We believe that you will enjoy the game anyway;)
Many thanks for all your support.

notes.title: Update 0.56.001
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33845009/55500c686175bc26d432934d849fe8377e3e7aa7.png

Hello everyone,

Finally, we managed to complete the last major translations of the game.
And for these languages:

 Simplified Chinese
 Japanese
 German
 Polish


It was necessary to make some adjustments to the game code and the logic for the game's overall translations. But at this time, this complex and uncomfortable (for development - but all the more important) feature is already complete. It took us a little more time than we expected (plus a little rest from the work;)).

But most importantly, this is our first finished major task, and now we finally can add new content and fine-tune the game.

Thanks a lot for all your support.

Enjoy the game!

And if you like our game, don't forget to write a small review here on Steam;)

Thanks a lot.

Known issue
In the game, there is a sharp decline in FPS if you have more than 50-80 archers.
We know about this problem - and we know how to solve it (but it is a big hit that can not be done from day to day). This drop in FPS does not, however, fundamentally interfere with the basic playability of the game.

notes.title: Update 0.55.001 - 003
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33845009/8554ee1ce5a9f19818ac53ec777bb04b30bd54cc.png

Hello everyone,

so we have the first week of the game available to the public.
We want to thank you and your support. 

And also we ask you to leave a small review here on Steam - it's really crucial for the game, and the game needs more than 50 reviews from Steam buyers (not from keys - Humble Store etc.). Otherwise, Steam will stop showing it to new potential customers (which happened yesterday). Therefore, if you find a time, we will be very happy.
We will certainly welcome also reviews from key  (if you bought the game outside of the steam or obtained another way).

We are still focusing on minor fixes or language support (depending on how our fans come to us and offer translation assistance).

And we follow your comments and ideas.

Above all, we want to thank the "Alis" fan who create into proofreading of the Japanese translation. We have implemented this proofreading, although the final translation is still in production. So perhaps this tiny proofreading will come in handy for some Japanese players.
